name: BrowserSessionAndCsrfV1
session_store: host-memory only; keyed by SHA-256(session_id) with no raw token in diagnostic/audit state
issue: after password or validated auto-login authentication generate independent 32-byte session_id and 32-byte csrf_token
bind to current run_id, actor_id, exact canonical origin and monotonic issue/last-seen state
set opaque session cookie HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; host-only; no Domain
return csrf_token only in authenticated same-origin bootstrap response body, never URL
query_validation: resolve cookie session id and constant-time compare hash lookup
require session run_id=current run and idle/absolute deadlines valid
reject Forwarded/X-Forwarded-Host/X-Forwarded-Proto influence because proxy headers are disabled
refresh last-seen monotonic state after successful validation within bounded write-free memory operation
mutation_validation: require exact Origin equal canonical origin; missing/null/cross-origin Origin rejected
require X-SOMA-CSRF header exactly equal session csrf_token using constant-time comparison
reject Sec-Fetch-Site values other than same-origin/none when header is present
then yield AuthenticatedBrowserContextV1 to route/command adapter

expiry.password_change_or_reset: all sessions except newly reauthenticated initiating flow invalidated

rules: GET/HEAD routes never mutate accepted state
CORS is disabled; no Access-Control-Allow-Origin wildcard/reflection
CSRF token alone is not authentication
session cookie is intentionally not marked Secure because the accepted origin is HTTP loopback; host-only+SameSite+exact Host/Origin+CSRF are mandatory compensating controls
